dialogues.speaker: Fushizome
dialogues.text: Ah, a fragrance wafts from the two of you. You must both be connoisseurs of the finer things in life...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Huh. Do we smell that nice, {NICKNAME}? Let Paimon try...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oooh, you do smell of Matsutake Meat Rolls! Guess this lady's right on the Mora, huh?

choices.text: I don't think she's talking about that kind of fragrance, Paimon...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's true. And with this familiar opening... Ooh, Paimon gets it! Is this lady gonna need our help as well?

response.speaker: Fushizome
response.text: Indeed, I believe that you will serve as dutiful guides and bring more customers in, but I'd prefer that you be able to enjoy this festival as a customer.

response.speaker: Fushizome
response.text: Would you two like to give it a try if you have time? Creating a "floral courtyard" of your very own, that is.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's a "floral courtyard"?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sure, I'd like to find out.

response.speaker: Fushizome
response.text: As you can see, I am a florist. The arrangement of these flower stands behind me is the "floral courtyard" — arranged according to the principles of "ikebana."

response.speaker: Fushizome
response.text: To place carefully trimmed flowers into their respective vessels and add on various accessories to create a courtyard-like scene on the table. This is the "floral courtyard" — the crystallization of the floral arts.

response.speaker: Fushizome
response.text: With the aid of the Yashiro Commission, I am taking part in the Irodori Festival with a variety of "floral courtyards," in the hopes that we might introduce the beauty of the floral arts to our guests.

response.speaker: Fushizome
response.text: If you're interested, please feel free to give it a go.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh... These floral artworks really are super pretty, and they look really elegant too. But it looks tough. Can we really do it?

choices.text: Worried about your handicraft skills, Paimon?

response.speaker: Fushizome
response.text: Please do not worry.

response.speaker: Fushizome
response.text: To help our guests truly appreciate the charm of this art, I have prepared a great number of items that can simplify the construction process.

response.speaker: Fushizome
response.text: You just need to select the main flower, the floral scene, and the base, before combining these elements to create your very own "floral courtyard."

response.speaker: Fushizome
response.text: Of course, the important thing is to experience "expressing yourself through the floral arts." As such, I will give you four "floral themes" to test your thinking a little.

response.speaker: Fushizome
response.text: If you complete the theme on each day, you will be able to take the corresponding "floral courtyards" and flowers back with you as mementos, along with some extra prizes.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really? That's awesome!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hehe, come on, {NICKNAME}, since this lady's put in so much effort, let's lend her a hand, shall we?

choices.text: We'll do it for the beauty of the floral arts...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright then, let's start now! Let's make our own... Uh, what was it again? Right! Our very own "floral courtyards"!

response.speaker: Fushizome
response.text: Hahaha. You have my thanks for your enthusiasm...

response.speaker: Fushizome
response.text: Well, then let's begin, shall we? The theme for today is "The purple sakura lies sparse, the clear sand is fragrant."

response.speaker: Fushizome
response.text: Ponder the meaning of this theme, and focus on the flowers and the various other utensils to create your very own "floral courtyard."

choices.text: We'll do it for the extra prizes...
Too used to doing things in large strides, Paimon?
Paimon, I think you're missing the point...
